notes.title: Game Release
notes.content: The release took place. Have a good game, everyone.

notes.title: The game is set to release on May 22nd!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I’ve got some great news — development on Pieces of Me is complete!
I’m now finishing up the final round of testing and preparing for release.

Stay tuned for updates and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist —
your support means a lot at this stage ❤️

Are you ready to discover the continuation of the [u]"September 7th"[/u] story?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249160/September_7th/
